summary: Iteration 21 – SiteTexts (admin editable UI strings), 2FA endpoints, and regression on public endpoints. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing (site-texts CRUD + auth/pub protection, 2FA setup→enable→disable using pyotp, regression on public-birds/found-birds/settings/prices/homepage/discount-codes). Frontend: /admin/texter loads with all groups (60+ keys), Save works, PublicHeader shows login/my-birds/admin correctly, Login/Register/ReportMissing/ReportFound/FoundBirdsList/Landing render their titles with proper data-testid. Contact page is MISSING the required data-testid attributes for title/subtitle (see bug below).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid="contact-title" and data-testid="contact-subtitle" on the H1 and paragraph rendered at lines 48-54. Text is also hard-coded ("Hör av dig" / static string) instead of using useSiteText('contact.title', 'Hör av dig') and useSiteText('contact.subtitle', ...). Admins therefore CANNOT override the Contact page title/subtitle from /admin/texter, contradicting the review request. Note: contact-email-link and contact-phone-link already do use useSiteText correctly.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/public/Contact.jsx (lines ~48-54), wrap the H1 text with useSiteText('contact.title', 'Hör av dig') and add data-testid="contact-title". Do the same for the subtitle paragraph with useSiteText('contact.subtitle', '<current default>') and data-testid="contact-subtitle". This aligns Contact.jsx with the pattern already used on RegisterBird, ReportMissing, ReportFound, FoundBirdsList, OwnershipTransfer, MyBirds and Login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is nearing 3830 lines — should be split into routers (auth, birds, admin, site_texts, 2fa) for maintainability.

PATCH /api/admin/site-texts/{key} does not validate the key against a known allowlist — any admin can create arbitrary keys that will pollute the public dict. Consider validating against SiteTexts.KNOWN_KEYS.

No DELETE endpoint on /admin/site-texts/{key}; currently the UI only supports setting a value to empty (fallback applies), but there's no way to truly remove a key from the collection. Minor, but worth documenting or adding.

SiteTextsContext fetches on mount only — after a PATCH from admin UI it relies on client-side refresh(). Public visitors won't see the change until they reload the tab. This is by design per the context note, but worth surfacing in UI copy so admins understand.

rca of the issue: Contact.jsx was never migrated to the useSiteText pattern for its H1/subtitle. The other public pages (RegisterBird, ReportMissing, ReportFound, FoundBirdsList, Landing, Login) were correctly wired up, but Contact was missed. Since the review explicitly names data-testid='contact-title' as required and expects admin edits to reflect on /kontakt, this counts as an incomplete implementation. Reproduction: navigate to /kontakt and query the DOM for [data-testid='contact-title'] — returns null. Fix: import { useSiteText } from '@/context/SiteTextsContext' (already imported), then replace the hard-coded H1 and P text with the hook + data-testid.
